layers.name: Antarctic Research Facilities
layers.license: Educational and non-commercial use only. COMNAP 2024.
layers.description: All 81 Antarctic facilities with status Open or Temporarily Closed, from 30 COMNAP member National Antarctic Programs. Includes year-round stations and seasonal/summer facilities. Used for Remoteness (isolation from infrastructure) and Wildness (sight/sound impact zone) indicators.
layers.citation: COMNAP (2024). Antarctic Facilities List, Version 3.5.0. Council of Managers of National Antarctic Programs, Christchurch, New Zealand. https://www.comnap.aq/antarctic-facilities-information

layers.name: ATS Land-based Visitor Sites
layers.description: All 331 ATS-reported land-based visitor sites with 5-year visit totals across five seasons (2019/20–2023/24). Peninsula sites (region P) dominate with 281 of 331 sites. Used for Remoteness and Wildness indicator scoring.
layers.citation: ATS (2025). Land-based Visited Sites. Antarctic Treaty Secretariat. https://antarctictreaty.maps.arcgis.com. Dataset compiled by Walden-Schreiner, C. (2025) for ANT-MICI WP3.

layers.name: Inviolate Antarctic Wilderness
layers.description: 50 km resolution grid cells with no recorded human visitation 1819–2018, based on ~2.7 million ground-based activity records. 1733 cells = 4,332,500 km² of inviolate wilderness. Used as baseline for Pristineness indicator.
layers.citation: Leihy, R.I., Coetzee, B.W.T., Morgan, F., Raymond, B., Shaw, J.D., Terauds, A., Bastmeijer, K. & Chown, S.L. (2020). Antarctica's wilderness fails to capture continent's biodiversity. Nature, 583, 567–571. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-020-2506-3

raster_bounds.note: Rasters cover Antarctica south of 60°S in EPSG:3031, displayed as image overlays within these WGS84 bounds.

references: Leihy, R.I. et al. (2020). Antarctica's wilderness fails to capture continent's biodiversity. Nature, 583, 567–571.
Summerson, R. (2012). Protection of wilderness and aesthetic values in Antarctica. Polar Record, 48(4), 389–399.
Summerson, R. & Bishop, I.D. (2012). Aesthetics of the Antarctic landscape. Polar Research, 31, 10858.
New Zealand (2013). Monitoring and assessment of aesthetic values of the Antarctic environment. ATCM XXXVI IP 39.
Hughes, K.A. et al. (2011). Persistent organic pollutants in the Antarctic coastal environment. Antarctic Science, 23(6), 537–548.
COMNAP (2024). Antarctic Facilities List, Version 3.5.0. COMNAP, Christchurch.
ATS (2025). Land-based Visited Sites. Antarctic Treaty Secretariat.
data_gaps: Deep-field tourism sites — no freely available georeferenced dataset
Vessel-based visitor sites — not yet integrated
COMNAP building footprint polygons — institutional access required; point data used
Soundscape measurements — audibility not empirically modelled continent-wide
Night-sky light pollution — not modelled at 50 km grid scale
Non-station infrastructure (fuel depots, AWS, field huts) — incomplete coverage
